name: Cereals
description: Grain crops grown for food including rice, wheat, maize, millets, sorghum, barley

name: Pulses
description: Leguminous crops harvested for dry seed including chickpea, pigeon pea, lentils, green gram, black gram

name: Oilseeds
description: Crops grown primarily for extracting edible or industrial oils including groundnut, mustard, soybean, sunflower, sesame

name: Fruits
description: Horticultural fruit crops including mango, banana, citrus, guava, papaya, apple, grape

name: Vegetables
description: Horticultural vegetable crops including tomato, onion, potato, brinjal, okra, cauliflower, cabbage

name: Fibre Crops
description: Crops grown for fibre including cotton, jute, hemp, flax

name: Cash Crops
description: Crops grown for commercial value including sugarcane, tobacco, rubber

name: Plantation Crops
description: Perennial tree crops grown on plantations including tea, coffee, coconut, arecanut, oil palm

name: Spices
description: Aromatic crops used for flavoring including turmeric, chilli, ginger, garlic, coriander, cumin, black pepper, cardamom

name: Medicinal Crops
description: Crops grown for medicinal and aromatic properties including ashwagandha, tulsi, aloe vera, senna, isabgol

name: Commercial Crops
description: Crops grown for industrial and commercial processing including indigo, lac, natural dyes

name: Fodder Crops
description: Crops grown as animal feed including berseem, lucerne, napier grass, guinea grass, oats
